claim: Resource policy validation and the BlockPublicPolicy parameter help prevent public access from being granted through resource policies attached directly to secrets; AWS says to also inspect identity-based policies attached to associated principals such as IAM roles, and resource-based policies attached to associated resources such as AWS KMS keys.

qualifiers.condition: inspect identity-based policies and resource-based policies of associated resources, such as KMS keys, separately

evidence.quote: Resource policy validation and the `BlockPublicPolicy` parameter help protect your resources by preventing public access from being granted through the resource policies that are directly attached to your secrets. In addition to using these features, carefully inspect the following policies to confirm that they do not grant public access:
evidence.title: Resource-based policies

evidence.quote: Identity-based policies attached to associated AWS principals (for example, IAM roles)
Resource-based policies attached to associated AWS resources (for example, AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys)
